outcome.text: SUCCESS (jaw arm, G06 scored seed 0). Front camera with contact decides opposition, held and moving-with-robot as they happen; the overhead camera under the hand reports occlusion and its pose predicates stay unknown.

notes: See docs/results/g09-report.md.
